critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a rotation transform to the wing primitives along their local normal axis (perpendicular to the fuselage) to increase the rearward sweep angle from approximately 15 degrees to 35 degrees, ensuring the leading edge aligns with the intended aerodynamic profile of the Boeing 747.

discrepancies.observed: Two engines visible under the wing
Wings are nearly perpendicular to the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Significant rearward sweep of the wings
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: rotate wing primitives backward along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: Engines are positioned close to the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Engines are spaced out along the leading edge of the wing
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: move engine primitives outward away from the fuselage

discrepancies.observed: Wings appear as thin, flat planes
discrepancies.reference: Wings have significant aerodynamic thickness and airfoil shape
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase thickness dimension of wing primitives
